name: OpenAPI to Postman Collection
description: Convert an OpenAPI 3.x (or Swagger 2.0) spec — JSON or YAML — into a Postman Collection v2.1.0 JSON that imports cleanly into the Postman app and runs in Newman. Folders by path trie or tags, maps path/query/header parameters, generates JSON bodies with deterministic sample values from schemas, saves example responses, converts security schemes to bearer/basic/apiKey auth, and emits {{baseUrl}} plus server variables.
